<title level="1" pfs="">[Giant Fangtooth](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3278)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

A single bite from this creature's signature fangs can cause death by blood loss within minutes; what's worse, the giant fangtooth is willing to attack creatures far larger than itself.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 19

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14
</column>

<trait label="Animal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=531" />
<trait label="Aquatic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=533" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 149

**Perception** +14; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 120 feet, [wavesense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=84) ([precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411)) 30 feet

**Languages**

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +11, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +14

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +5

**Dex** +2

**Con** +3

**Int** -5

**Wis** +2

**Cha** -1
</row>

**Sunless Sight** In an area of [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407), the giant fangtooth is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) and [slowed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92).

</column>

<column gap="tiny">

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +8 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 75

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** swim 35 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
bite +15,
**Damage** 2d8+5 piercing plus deep puncture and [Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=45)

**Deep Puncture**   Creatures critically hit by the fangtooth's bite take an additional 1d8 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).

**[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** <actions string="Single Action" />  2d8 piercing, DC 21

</column>
